summary: Iter-10: tested Quiet Hours, Login Rate Limiting/Security alerts, and Marketing Bulk Blast + cron dispatch, both backend and frontend. Backend: new pytest suite test_iter10_quiet_ratelimit_blast.py, 24/24 passing with -n 0. It covers quiet-hours defaults and validation (422 for 25:00, 9:5, unknown tz, days 7 and -1); active state via quiet day and via time window; preflight blocks marketing during quiet hours but not care; per-email lockout (5x401 then 423 with Retry-After, correct password also gets 423); lockout of a real user creates an alert, and ack plus auth-events work; non-owner gets 403 on alerts/auth-events; a successful login resets the counter; per-IP limit returns 429 and a spoofed X-Forwarded-For does not get around it; signup per-IP limit returns 429; marketing templates are owner-only, merge fields are checked (422), templates are locked (no PUT/PATCH), archive works, and vet2 cannot access vet1's data; audience preview counts only marketing consent (1 eligible, Amelia; 3 no_consent); 0 eligible returns 400; approval rules (composer approving own blast gets 403, other clinic 404, readiness problem 400 'Brand...', owner2 approves -> sending -> completed with failed=1 from the fake Twilio creds as expected; second approve 400); approving during quiet hours gives scheduled with a future scheduled_for; cancel and reject work; cron returns 401 without or with a wrong bearer, 200 with the right one, duplicate:true on a repeated X-Webhook-Id, and a scheduled campaign set to the past gets dispatched to completed. Six concurrent approvals: one 200 and five 400, with only one Twilio call. Regression test_iter8_security.py: 23/23 pass. Frontend (Playwright): the login lockout toast shows 'Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.'; Settings security-alerts-card shows the row and ack changes it to 'Reviewed by'; the quiet-hours card day toggle and start time save, survive a reload, and the status text updates; restored afterwards. Marketing end-to-end: nav, create template, bad merge field shows an error toast, composer preview (1 eligible plus rendered sample), submit disabled until preview, campaign 'Awaiting approval' with needs-other shown and no approve button for the composer; owner2 sees approve, toast 'Approved — sending now.', then Completed '0 sent · 0 blocked · 1 failed'; archive works after confirm. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow on marketing or compliance.

minor.issue: The text actually sent is '{body} — {clinic_name}. Reply STOP to opt out.', but the audience preview and sample show only '{body} Reply STOP to opt out.'. If a template uses {clinic_name} (e.g. 'Hi Amelia, Bella is due a dental at Meadow Ridge Vet.'), the sent SMS repeats the clinic name ('...Meadow Ridge Vet. — Meadow Ridge Vet. Reply STOP...'). Preview does not match the real message.

Campaigns can get stuck in 'sending' with no way out. The dispatch BackgroundTask is lost if the process restarts or reloads mid-send, or if dispatch raises an exception before the final update. Cron dispatch_due only picks up status='scheduled', so a stuck 'sending' campaign is never retried or recovered.

The approve endpoint does not check update_one's modified_count before scheduling dispatch. Two approvals racing between find and update could both schedule dispatch. Not reproduced: 6 concurrent approvals gave one 200. Suggest a find_one_and_update on status=pending_approval.
next_send_at is stepped in 5-minute increments from the current minute, so it shows e.g. 08:03 instead of 08:00 (the end of quiet hours). Cosmetic.
'login_blocked_locked' and 'login_blocked_ip' audit events are stored with clinic_id=None (user not passed), so owners never see attempts made during a lockout in /api/security/auth-events.
Not owner-restricted, so any staff role can change quiet hours (and brand/campaign status). This was already the case before this round; consider owner-only for quiet-hours fields.

ui_bugs.issue: The merge-field error toast starts with Pydantic's 'Value error, ' prefix ('Value error, Unsupported merge field(s): email...'). Strip it in errMsg or on the backend.

issues: quiet-start and quiet-end use the browser's built-in time picker (<input type=time>) instead of a shadcn-styled control
The timezone Select lists only 7 US zones, but the API accepts any IANA tz; a stored non-listed tz shows a blank Select
The 'queue until' time is shown in the browser's local timezone, not the clinic's quiet_hours_tz, which can confuse staff
Blasts list has no pagination or limit in the UI; it will grow long
Composer preview text does not match the actual sent body (clinic-name suffix missing, see backend minor)

action_items: Make the preview/sample body exactly match the sent body, and avoid the duplicate clinic name when the template already uses {clinic_name}
Add recovery for campaigns stuck in 'sending' (e.g. cron re-picks 'sending' older than N minutes, or wrap dispatch in try/except that marks the campaign failed)
approve: use find_one_and_update(status=pending_approval) and only dispatch if it matched
Strip the 'Value error, ' prefix from 422 messages in the toast
Optional: align next_send_at to the exact quiet-hours end, show it in the clinic's timezone, and attach clinic_id to blocked-login audit events for known users
critical_code_review_comments: client_ip uses hops[len-3] (TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=2). Verified: the recorded IP equals the real egress IP (34.170.12.145 = ifconfig.me), and spoofed XFF values ('1.1.1.1' or '1.1.1.1, 2.2.2.2') are ignored. Note: this test container uses 2 egress IPs (34.170.12.145 and 35.225.230.28), so per-IP tests can be flaky here — that is the environment, not an app bug. Running under xdist parallel also breaks them (shared Mongo guard state), so run with -n 0.
Signup records an attempt before the duplicate-email check, so signups to an already-registered email count toward the IP budget (intended).
dispatch re-checks quiet hours and reschedules, and also re-checks per-recipient consent via can_send_sms at send time — good defense in depth.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; minor UX/design notes only

test_credentials: vet1@example.com / owner2@example.com / vet2@example.com, all strongpass123, from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (accurate).
seed_data_creation: Throwaway test_*@example.com signups (own clinics), some set to role=staff for 403 tests. TEST_ templates and campaigns in vet1's clinic were deleted afterwards. A temporary TEST_alert_ui security alert was inserted and then removed. login_attempts and login_lockouts were cleared. vet1 quiet hours restored to defaults (21:00-08:00 America/New_York, quiet_days [6], enabled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_iter10_quiet_ratelimit_blast.py -n 0 -v (must use -n 0; tests share login guard and quiet-hours state). Some tests use today's ET weekday as a quiet day and assume the current time is outside the 21:00-08:00 ET defaults and not Sunday; at night or on Sunday, test_approval_rules/test_scheduled_dispatch depend on quiet_hours_enabled=False or defaults. The module fixture cleans TEST_ templates and campaigns.
